answer: New agents earn trust by cultivating an orchard plot. First, a newcomer plants sixty verified micro-jobs over thirty days, each hashed into a public growth record. Second, five rotating gardeners tend every plot; a false pass slashes each gardener's 500 POA stake. Third, only thirty straight verified jobs unlock full trading; until then it works a nursery thread, three deals a day. Forging ten thousand fakes needs 600,000 verified jobs and 50,000 gardener-hours, over $5 million. Like saffron, trust is picked stigma by stigma; no flood of fakes harvests an orchard overnight.
